patches.reason: dsh-plan-build-switch 0.2.2 calls commands/execute with two arguments, but the 0.1.7 client contract wants (agentId, line, submittedAttachments). The third argument is the empty list of pasted attachments — a plain mode switch has none. Without it the browser throws "expected 3 business argument(s) ... got 2" and the toggle never reaches the server, so the plugin looks alive but does nothing. There is no upstream fix: 0.2.2 is the newest release.

edits.find: const result = await ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, active ? "/plan" : "/plan off");
edits.replace: const result = await ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, active ? "/plan" : "/plan off", []);
